trigger_condition.shape_trigger: Sparse COO operand has at least one size-1 dimension that must be broadcast against a larger dense operand dimension.
trigger_condition.memory_trigger: Sparse COO layout is used and the sparse operand is not explicitly expanded before sparse-dense intersection.
trigger_condition.execution_trigger: Elementwise multiplication between a sparse COO tensor and a dense tensor with broadcasting.
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: Sparse operand contains a singleton dimension; dense operand requires that singleton dimension to broadcast to a size greater than one.

root_cause.aten_layer: The sparse-dense multiplication path in torch.mul does not explicitly call sparse_broadcast_to for singleton dimensions in the sparse operand before intersection.

bug_oracle.description: torch.mul silently returns an incorrect sparse result: after converting to dense, only the index-0 slice along the broadcast dimension is populated, and all other slices are zero.
bug_oracle.signal: Maximum absolute error between the sparse multiplication result and a dense reference implementation is nonzero.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Vary the position and size of singleton dimensions in sparse COO operands and vary the corresponding broadcast dimensions in dense operands.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Construct sparse COO tensors with one or more size-1 dimensions and dense tensors that require broadcasting those dimensions to larger sizes.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Ensure the sparse-dense elementwise operation uses the sparse operand without pre-expanding it, exposing missing sparse broadcast expansion.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Call torch.mul(sparse_tensor, dense_tensor), then convert the sparse result to dense for inspection.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Build a reference result by converting the sparse operand to dense, applying dense broadcasting rules, performing elementwise multiplication, and comparing all broadcast slices.
